text:
mark: FYI Praxis Health RFI arrived. They want: capability matrix, security questionnaire, POC plan, and ballpark pricing for a 3-month pilot by EOD Friday. Who takes which piece?
jen: I can own pricing + SOW. Need guidance on Dedicated commit tiers and burst pricing.
samir: Ill handle the POC plan and perf tests. When can infra provision GPUs?
ellie: Ill do security answers. Need details on Private HSM flow, VPC peering, and audit log retention wording.
sec-bot: Compliance pack v3.1 available: https://drive.redwood/compliance/packs/security-compliance-v3.1.zip (updated 2025-01-12).
mark: Praxis requires BYOK for PHI. We support KMS BYOK for Hosted and HSM for Private only. Call this out.
jen: Noted. For pricing estimate: Praxis expects ~200 req/s steady. What commit + GPU mix do we propose?
samir: POC ask: 2x a100-equivalent nodes for 2 weeks, 5k prompts (seq_len=512), measure p50/p95 token latency and throughput, 3 runs over 24h. Ops: can you provision Wed?
ellie: Will include KMS/HSM checklist, enrollment steps, and a simple network diagram. Also include fallback audit logging requirement.
mark: Product note: 4-bit quantized variants are experimental for some models. If quality drops, auto-fallback to float model should be documented.
jen: Ill draft two pricing scenarios: hosted (per-token + overage) and Dedicated reserve with burst. Draft by tomorrow AM.
samir: I have a token-cost CSV template; will sanitize and drop into Drive.
ellie: PHI appendix: minimal data handling steps + redaction guidance.
mark: Action recap: Jen = pricing + packet; Ellie = security answers + network diag; Samir = POC perf plan + runbook; Mark = legal + infra booking.
sec-bot: Reminder: attach completed security pack link when packet uploaded.
jen: Will upload capability matrix + pricing + SOW to Drive by 9am tomorrow and link in RFI packet.
mark: If Praxis flags feature gaps, escalate to prod@redwood. Aim to deliver full packet Friday morning. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
